metadata.source: PSOC - Detects suspicious New Inbox Rule creation of less than 6 characters.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detects suspicious New Inbox Rule creation of less than 6 characters
properties.description:
after a phish, attackers can create rules with short names to hide their tracks
these rules may hide emails by deleting or archiving them, or forward mails to an attacker
properties.query:
//after a phish, attackers can create rules with short names to hide their tracks
//these rules may hide emails by deleting or archiving them, or forward mails to an attacker
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "New-InboxRule"
| parse Parameters with * '{"Name":"Name","Value":"'RuleName'"}' *
| where strlen(RuleName) <= 6
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("UserId", ""))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    RecordType,
    UserType,
    Account,
    Operation,
    RuleName,
    RuleNameLength = strlen(RuleName),
    Type,
    OrganizationName,
    ResultStatus
